Title: Configure backup for Azure file shares directly from the file share blade

Body.Content:
Azure Backup has simplified the experience of configuring backup for Azure file shares by giving you the ability to seamlessly enable backup from the file share management blade. With the integration of Azure Backup into file share management blade, you can perform the backup and restore related operations directly from the file share blade, as well as the recovery services vault blade.

You can now protect your Azure file shares with a simple two-step backup configuration process that involves creating or selecting an existing recovery services vault and creating or selecting an existing backup policy that meets your retention requirements.

Learn how to enable backup from Azure file share blade
